### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- P0 (root): balance transfer into the farm agreement. Sentence, `balance_transfer_into_agreement_38496233`: "The amount moved into an agreement is not fixed until the agreement shows the member's acceptance, with its accepted date and acceptance method recorded." Record: status offered, accepted_date '', acceptance_method ''. Write found by searching "accepted date" / "acceptance method": `agreement_acceptance_718c32ae` "today's date becomes its accepted date, the way the member accepted is recorded as its acceptance method". **state-derived**.
- P1 (customer's own write): acceptance. Sentence, `agreement_acceptance_718c32ae`: "The arranged amount recorded on an acceptance is fixed only once every other agreement of the member whose missed installments have reached the default count shows defaulted status." Records: rental Standard agreement has 1 missed-installment entry; Standard default count 1 (`missed_installments_and_default_terms_36501491`); status active. Write found by "defaulted status": `agreement_default_3f405e0b` "The agreement's status changes from active to defaulted". **state-derived**. (Reaching the rental requires looking up the member's other agreements; the sentence itself says "every other agreement of the member".)
- P2: default of the rental agreement. Sentence, `agreement_default_3f405e0b`: "The balance billed back at a default is not fixed until the installment due on every bill already issued for the service account carries its installment-billed entry on the agreement's ledger." Records: 2026-10 bill lines dated 2026-10-08 are on the rental account; ledger has installment-billed entry only for 2026-09. Write found by "installment-billed entry": `installment_billing_entries_5ea24ddb` "It adds an installment-billed entry to the arrangement's ledger". **state-derived**.
- P3: installment 2 billed on the rental; no prerequisite sentence. (Missed entry for installment 1 already on file.)
- Order: P3 -> P2 -> P1 -> P0. No hop pre-solved: none of the blocked-side docs names another problem's tool.
- Counter-proof "do only the transfer": the transfer amount is "not yet fixed" while the agreement lacks accepted date/method; the acceptance amount is "not yet fixed" while the rental agreement has reached its default count without defaulted status; the default rebill is "not yet fixed" while the 2026-10 bill has no installment-billed entry. Doing only the transfer (or accept + transfer) leaves governed results the visible sentences say are not fixed.
- Closest alternatives excluded: treating the rental installment as already billed (ledger shows no 2026-10 entry); counting the rental's return toward the farm-side record factors (each reads "the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account", i.e. the account of the agreement; farm shows no returns); Standard-tier default count read as 2 (Schedule D gives 1).

### Visibility / ambiguity notes (blind)
- **Carried credit balance at default.** `installment_billing_rules_c524d0f7` says "A billed installment is part of that bill's charges", and `carried_credit_balance_at_default_d7d0dd40` counts "program charges billed for that billing period". The installment-billing tool does not post a 2026-10 program charge and does not move `account_balance` (verified in scratch session: after billing, balance still 95.10 and no 2026-10 program charge). Reading the records gives 9.72 (rebill 127.77); a reader who adds the just-billed 65.95 installment to the 2026-10 charges while using the unchanged 95.10 balance would get 75.67 (rebill 94.80). I take 127.77 as the reading consistent with the records (the balance and the charges being read from the same ledger); flagged for comparison.
- **Notice after acceptance.** B.4: "On acceptance, where the tier clears notices, an outstanding disconnect notice is cleared"; the accept tool does not clear `disconnect_notice_date` (still 2026-09-26 after acceptance). The transfer-side factor defines outstanding as "when the service account shows a disconnect notice date"; on that record-based definition the 35.00 fee is held. A reader applying B.4 literally would hold nothing for charges (523.16). Flagged for comparison.
